description:
You release a narrow astral frost cone that reaches up to 6 tiles, dealing ::damage ::damage_type damage and piercing through all enemies caught in its side‑shaped area.
The chilling impact inflicts frostbite and generates astral frost stacks.
If too many stacks accumulate, the backlash applies debuffs to you.
This spell ignores party members.
name: Astral Frostline
